parsed.name: UDP广播数值订阅组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于在局域网中监听UDP广播数据包并接收远程发布的数值消息。在实验环境中可用于在不同主机或进程之间传递传感器读数、状态量或控制参数，便于监视、联动和数据整合。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that listens for UDP broadcast packets on a local network and receives value messages from a remote publisher. In lab workflows, it can be used to pass sensor readings, status values, or control parameters between hosts or processes for monitoring, coordination, and data integration.

actions.description: 同步监听一次UDP广播消息并返回接收到的值。
actions.description_en: Synchronously listen for one UDP broadcast message and return the received value.

actions.description: 读取后台更新线程当前缓存的最新值。
actions.description_en: Read the latest value currently cached by the background update thread.

actions.description: 持续轮询UDP广播并更新内部保存的最新值。
actions.description_en: Continuously poll UDP broadcasts and update the internally stored latest value.

actions.description: 阻塞等待一条UDP广播数据包并解析其中的值。
actions.description_en: Block until a UDP broadcast packet is received and parse the value it contains.

actions.description: 停止订阅循环并关闭该接收组件的运行过程。
actions.description_en: Stop the subscription loop and shut down the receiver component's operation.
